label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is http://<user_input>/api where <user_input> comes directly from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). User-controlled param flows to host variable, which is used in DNS resolution (line 41) and then in the outbound fetch (line 43 via connectHttpByHostname). The isNonPublicAddress check validates IPs AFTER DNS resolution, allowing attackers to bypass by providing hostnames that resolve to internal IPs. This is a classic SSRF: untrusted input reaches the network sink.

evidence.note: User param assigned to host, then used in DNS resolution and outbound fetch
